s.en: Receive what is pushed into the repository

o.en: Used by git-http-backend(1) to serve up $GIT_URL/info/refs?service=git-receive-pack requests. See --http-backend-info-refs in git-upload-pack(1).

Bypasses the connectivity checks that validate the existence of all objects in the transitive closure of reachable objects. This option is intended for server operators that want to implement their own object connectivity validation outside of Git.
